## Current acceptance checkpoint

Runtime acceptance PASSED for development candidate 0.14.14 in run9396a6e342f449c9886c06f51d3a7878. Player confirms normal movement and correctly grounded blue capsule. All143 authoritative samples have Y1; initial spawn(3,1,3); signed admission and starting-town geometry ACK recorded. Client exit0, no captured runtime errors, local and remote cleanup verified. Assessment retained beside raw logs. Full GUT140/140 scripts and record-sync pass in an owned private-network validation container; original shared-port failure evidence retained. Existing saved checkpoints were not migrated.

DELIVERED through PR #1224. Fix commit 3ae2d0e8b3dbcb9396dd6f3016571fddb30b44e0 merged into main as 3f3a76979073bbb3e66572c36df92b12659b8ee7 after all CI checks and review passed. Capsule runtime acceptance and cleanup are verified. Parent #1213 and town-exit investigation #1242 remain separate. No release tag, Windows client publication or server deployment was performed. Rollback is a normal revert PR for the bounded correction.

Parent issue: #1213
Parent feature: #551
Primary outcome: Authoritative content and game systems. Phase: M0 Solo Playable Foundation. Governing PR: #1224 (existing Windows candidate worktree).

## Problem and root cause
During authenticated paired run78c3d47bc48b4a55b973fd27ecc15d6b on SETSUJOKU, immutable standalone0.14.13 rendered the blue authoritative capsule partly underground while the red predicted body looked normal. The user confirmed movement otherwise feels normal. Authoritative samples show Y0. server_main selects spawn centers at Y1; JourneyRegistry.enter initializes every new journey to XYZ0; LoginGateway returns that record and network_client world entry restores it over the valid spawn. Centered height1.8 capsule geometry then intersects the floor. Local collision recovery explains the different rendering path, but its precise rendered transform was not measured. Earlier missing-mesh-offset hypothesis is superseded by this traced spawn overwrite.

## Scope and hypothesis
New authenticated journeys must initialize from the existing server-selected spawn position, never a client-selected position. Reclaims must preserve saved XYZ, including legitimate zero/elevated coordinates. Test seam: normal world-entry gateway through JourneyRegistry and the authoritative state restore call; real capsule bounds versus starting-floor top provide presentation acceptance. No arbitrary render offset or global Y correction.

## Acceptance
- Fresh authenticated entry preserves the server-selected grounded spawn.
- Distinct server-selected spawns remain distinct; repeated entry and reclaim do not reset saved checkpoints.
- Public-seam regression is red before the correction and green after it.
- Authentication, collision, frontier readiness and authoritative movement are unchanged.
- Windows-authored validation evidence; standard full gates where authorized; new immutable candidate and isolated paired check with player visual confirmation before final acceptance.
- Retained evidence and verified cleanup; linked PR and Project records synchronized.

## Safety and non-goals
No production deploy, publication, existing candidate0.14.13 mutation, Canon/authentication bypass, collision disabling, blanket persisted-position migration, launcher work or unrelated refactor. Legacy already-bad saved checkpoints are not silently rewritten; record any remaining remediation decision. Rollback is reverting only this bounded spawn-initialization change and removing owned test resources.

## Root-cause learning
Existing paired/source tests demonstrated movement/readiness but did not assert that authenticated entry preserves the grounded spawn coordinate or measure visible capsule ground alignment. Countermeasure: focused entry/spawn and reclaim regression plus packaged runtime visual acceptance. Remediation implemented locally; focused, full-suite, package and human paired-runtime validation passed. Commit and PR review completed in merged PR #1224. Classification: correctness regression, active liability. Owner: Copilot direct implementation, explicitly instructed by the user. Status: Closed after user-approved delivery through PR #1224.

milestone.title: Milestone 0: Solo Playable Foundation
milestone.description:
Outcome: One player proves standalone entry, movement/traversal, solo combat, and Mind versus Tool on the existing authoritative runtime.
Horizon: Current
Class: active

## Slice Mapping
### Slice M0.1: Standalone Entry
Outcome: A tester manually obtains a compatible Windows client, starts it without a launcher, authenticates, and enters over LAN and genuine external WAN.
Included issues:
- #1218
Complete when: Both access paths pass with recorded build identity and runtime admission evidence, preserving authentication, compatibility, artifact trust, and server authority. No launcher installation, process, or launcher-issued session is required.
Dependency: Known-good manually delivered standalone package; existing authentication and compatibility boundaries. Launcher work remains paused.
### Slice M0.2: Movement and Traversal
Outcome: One player completes a repeatable small-area route without rubberbanding or collision failures.
Included issues:
- #1213
Complete when: The owning movement/readiness defect is resolved with its required evidence, the repeatable traversal route passes on Windows, and the user approves responsiveness. Closing the defect alone is not route acceptance.
Dependency: M0.1 standalone admission and compatible client/server contracts; preserve unready-frontier protection.
### Slice M0.3: Solo Combat
Outcome: One player reads a telegraphed attack and responds through positioning and timing with correct authoritative combat outcomes.
Included issues:
- #1219
Complete when: One repeatable solo encounter records the telegraph, player response, and authoritative result; the user approves responsiveness. Stats do not make tactical decisions for the player.
Dependency: M0.1 and M0.2.
### Slice M0.4: Mind versus Tool
Outcome: A correct human-devised environmental solution is accepted independently of reasoning stats, while physical attributes affect execution.
Included issues:
- #1220
Complete when: One runtime interaction accepts the correct solution at low reasoning stats when physical requirements are met, contrasting physical execution profiles demonstrate an execution effect without a solution-permission gate, and the user approves the experience.
Dependency: M0.1 and M0.2; existing server-authoritative interaction contracts.

## Shared Context
- #495 Vision and authority boundaries.
- #318 Approved solo-first direction and indefinite launcher stop.
- #1217 Numbered milestone-to-slice mapping and dashboard alignment.

## Player Example
A tester downloads a known-good standalone Windows build, starts it directly, authenticates from LAN or WAN, traverses a small area, responds to an enemy attack, and solves an environmental interaction. The authoritative runtime recognizes the results. Existing Canon persistence contracts remain unchanged.

## Milestone Acceptance
All four groups need their own runtime outcome evidence plus explicit user approval of responsiveness and feel. Issue closure, unit tests, or a successful launch alone do not prove the playable route. One player uses the existing authoritative server; no offline/client-authoritative runtime is implied.
Manual replacement is acceptable. Launcher development is paused indefinitely until a concrete need and explicit user approval; neither M0 nor M1 completion restarts it.
No fixed date. Server/dashboard execution stays on 192.168.1.254 via SSH; Windows acceptance stays on the assigned Windows host.
## Previous Definition (Historical Context)
Approved roadmap: https://github.com/vnvalentin/project0/issues/318
Owner: vnvalentin. First committed gameplay gate; no fixed date. Runtime evidence and user playtest approval determine completion.

## Outcome
One player on the existing authoritative runtime proves responsive movement, spatial traversal, combat timing, and Mind versus Tool using a standalone Windows client. This is not offline or client-authoritative gameplay. Server execution remains on 192.168.1.254 via SSH.

## Player Example
A tester manually downloads a known-good build, starts the client without the launcher, authenticates over LAN or WAN, traverses a small area, responds to an enemy telegraph, and solves an environmental interaction. The server recognizes the resulting encounter and interaction state. Existing Canon persistence rules remain unchanged.

## Acceptance
- Standalone authenticated, compatible-client access works over both LAN and genuine external WAN, with no launcher installation, process, or launcher-provided session prerequisite.
- One repeatable route has no movement rubberbanding or collision failures.
- One telegraphed attack can be read and answered through positioning/timing with correct authoritative combat outcomes.
- One correct environmental solution is accepted regardless of reasoning stats; physical attributes affect execution, not the right to solve it.
- Windows host/build, access path, actions, results, and runtime evidence are recorded; the user approves responsiveness and feel.
- Authentication, session ownership, compatibility, authority, and existing artifact-trust safeguards remain intact.

## Ordering
Resolve the known starting-area movement blocker #1213 first; root cause is still unresolved. Standalone admission gaps are product work, not authorization to bypass safety. Existing #551 JIT/Canon obligations remain scoped to that Feature, not automatically imported wholesale here.
M0 passes before M1 shared-play acceptance. Manual client replacement is acceptable. Launcher development and automatic updates are paused indefinitely until a concrete need and explicit user approval, not until M0/M1 finishes. No current runtime success is claimed.

## Naming History
Former title: Milestone 0: Solo Playable Foundation
Stable GitHub milestone ID: 14. Renamed by #1217 without consolidating milestones, changing completion state, or authorizing new post-M1 scope.
